title: Astra is not even objectively, but factually much worse than Claude at everything for Roblox games.
author: HarderThanADiamond
selftext: I can say with using both for about a week Astra has not at one point even mildly made me happy, wheras when i switched to Claude it completely blew ChatGPT out of the water. and its with everything else, better writing, better coding, better design, better agents, there's not a point where Astra should be competing. Infact i think its about a sonnet 5.5 ultra level. I think the one thing ChatGPT does better is that its cheaper token wise. its a better simple chat bot than Gemini, not really Claude but i have to find wins for it somewhere. i just hate ChatGPT so much.

comments.author: No-Examination7560
comments.body: astra is good, but the tokens run out fast on the $20 subscription and it can't complete the majority of my projects in a go, it does like 20% of it maybe. Meanwhile i hear that claude 1 shots stuff??

replies.author: HarderThanADiamond
replies.body: its good at long winded stuff, i have the $20 subscription and it def does run out of tokens super quick. claude i wouldn't say one shots stuff tho either, it 100% does do a better job and does in three prompts what astra could never do.

replies.author: Charming_You_25
replies.body: I reach for fable 90% of the time but will say astra is better at brute forcing a solution. Hammering on edge cases tirelessly. Fable gives a great answer and gets lazy quickly. Astra gives an ok answer and keeps going

replies.author: I_Rarely_Jump
replies.body:
It also runs out really fast on the €100 plan, like I let astra do something and it'll cost 40% of usage, I let Opus 5.5 do the same thing and it only uses 2%.

OpenAI does seem to reset it often though, I've been getting random full resets like every other day

comments.author: KeenAsGreen
comments.body: All its good for is image generation. Evrything else its so far behind claude its not funny.

replies.author: HarderThanADiamond
replies.body: even then its like terrible, generating hair especially. i honestly want to believe astra was neutered cause i totally remember it being better like day one-ish.

comments.author: Limp_Bus3865
comments.body: I always say that any codex model is 10 times shittier than anything that anthropic makes. I have no idea why anyone would use openai models, when they can use opus

comments.author: DealerIcy3439
comments.body: I plan to try Roblox later and make something wholey simple, just as a sort of toes in the water kind of deal.
